audio.strategy: Live Web Audio synthesis: triangle fundamental plus a quiet sine overtone through a per-note ADSR-like gain envelope. This is an honestly labeled piano-like fallback, not a recorded sample set.

generatedSources.description: Triangle fundamental and sine overtone generated live for each key; no recordings or downloaded assets.

notes: Phase 1 exposes one playable synthesized piano-like voice only.
Panel controls other than the keyboard and sustain input are decorative presentation controls and are intentionally not connected to audio.
AudioContext creation is lazy and Web MIDI denial/unavailability is reported in the visible status text.
